name: Mutton Biryani
description: Fragrant basmati rice layered with tender spiced mutton, yogurt, tomatoes, fried onions, mint and whole spices.
method: Wash and soak the basmati rice for 30 minutes.
Brown the onions, then cook mutton with ginger-garlic paste, tomatoes, yogurt and biryani spices until tender.
Boil the rice with salt and whole spices until about three-quarters cooked, then drain.
Layer rice and mutton masala with mint, coriander, green chilies and lemon.
Cover tightly and cook on low heat for 20 minutes to finish on dum.
Rest briefly, fluff gently and serve with raita and salad.
